requirements.statement: The future oracle is Offline-owned and models the parent contract's exact five orthogonal axes; it does not import the VPN FSM as authority.
Inputs, clock, IDs, connectivity, consent/profile/model eligibility, retry budget and faults are injected deterministic values.
One reducer input selects at most one rule by (priority, secondaryOrder, ruleId); no match returns explicit NO_STATE_CHANGE.
The reducer preserves the exact five-key canonical state-vector encoding and its SHA-256 digest rule.

The parent contractId, exact 12-field flow ledger, exact 19-field queue ledger, inherited identifier formulas, lifecycle/nullability rules and flow-to-queue intent equality remain exact; raw identifiers never enter evidence.

Unresolved hash, non-deletion transition, invalid-input, counter, digest-correlation, restore-decoding and revalidation semantics remain fail-closed blockers until a later versioned decision freezes them; implementation may not guess them.
Exactly 26 semantic traces project the 26 parent scenarios and exactly 67 action events bijectively project their ordered action slots without deduplication.
The exact 15-row remote-deletion mapping, six pending substatuses, eight content-free errors and phase-derived hash invariants are preserved.
Same logical key plus same canonical input replays the same outcome with zero new effects; a different canonical input returns categorical mismatch, NO_STATE_CHANGE and zero effects.
Every effect counter is in {0,1}; local canonical truth is unchanged by wait, replay, restart or an unapplied remote candidate.
Immutable in-memory snapshot/restore yields the same state vector, ledgers, rule result and counters for the same injected continuation.
Evidence is typed, synthetic and content-free; monitor/model/capture/export traces validate only reducer and ledger shape.
The 13 operation labels are versioned I1 semantic labels only; lifecycle, calibration and restart actions use null.
Any missing pin, duplicate ID, incomplete coverage, nondeterministic input, forbidden API/data, invalid vector/deletion phase or inflated evidence claim fails closed.

hashContract.stateVectorCanonicalEncoding: UTF-8 JSON with keys emitted in exact stateVectorKeys order, JSON-escaped string values and no insignificant whitespace.
hashContract.stateVectorDigest: preStateDigest and postStateDigest are lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the canonical UTF-8 preStateVector and postStateVector respectively.
hashContract.flowQueueEquality: For the same intent, flow queueIntentIdHash equals queue-ledger intentIdHash.
hashContract.implementationRule: A later versioned decision must freeze every unresolved preimage before implementation; guessing is forbidden.

flowStateVectorContract.valueRule: Every value is one member of its corresponding frozen state catalog; extra or missing keys are forbidden.
flowStateVectorContract.canonicalEncoding: UTF-8 JSON with keys emitted in exactKeys order, JSON-escaped string values and no insignificant whitespace.
flowStateVectorContract.digestRule: preStateDigest and postStateDigest are lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the canonical UTF-8 preStateVector and postStateVector respectively.
flowStateVectorContract.identifierHashRule: processingRequestIdHash = lowercaseHex(SHA-256(UTF8(contractId + LF + "PROCESSING_REQUEST" + LF + opaqueProcessingRequestId))); queueIntentIdHash = lowercaseHex(SHA-256(UTF8(contractId + LF + "QUEUE_INTENT" + LF + opaqueQueueIntentId))); intentIdHash = lowercaseHex(SHA-256(UTF8(contractId + LF + "QUEUE_INTENT" + LF + opaqueQueueIntentId))). LF=U+000A; the UTF-8 input receives no normalization or whitespace insertion. Each hash is immutable for the same logical request or intent and is null only when that axis has no request or queue intent. For the same queue intent, flow-ledger queueIntentIdHash == queue-ledger intentIdHash; the two fields use the identical QUEUE_INTENT formula. Raw identifiers never enter public evidence.

queueLedgerDeletionContract.operationClassRule: Every remote-deletion row uses exact operationClass=DELETE_CLOUD_COPY, matching VPN-OP-008; non-deletion operation classes remain separately versioned and outside this deletion rule.
queueLedgerDeletionContract.intentIdHashRule: For the same queue intent, flow-ledger queueIntentIdHash == queue-ledger intentIdHash; intentIdHash = lowercaseHex(SHA-256(UTF8(contractId + LF + "QUEUE_INTENT" + LF + opaqueQueueIntentId))). LF=U+000A; the UTF-8 input receives no normalization or whitespace insertion, and the raw identifier never enters public evidence.
queueLedgerDeletionContract.primaryStateRule: Every deletion row has queueState DELETE_PENDING from durable enqueue through request acceptance and every retryable, final, revalidation or manual-retry-required non-receipt branch. Only a verified scoped receipt permits queueState DELETED_REMOTE. FAILED_RETRYABLE and FAILED_FINAL are allowed only for non-deletion rows.
queueLedgerDeletionContract.logicalKeyHashRule: Required and immutable from durable enqueue for a deletion row.
queueLedgerDeletionContract.deletionScopeDigestRule: Required and immutable from durable enqueue for a deletion row.
queueLedgerDeletionContract.deletionIdHashRule: Null before an accepted response; required and immutable after the accepted response.
queueLedgerDeletionContract.deletionReceiptIdHashRule: Null until the exact scoped receipt verifies; required and immutable after verification.
queueLedgerDeletionContract.deletionReceiptVerificationOutcomeRule: Null until the exact scoped receipt verifies; the DELETED_REMOTE row requires exact value VERIFIED.
queueLedgerDeletionContract.deletionSubstatusRule: Required and non-null only for DELETE_PENDING deletion rows, null for DELETED_REMOTE and all non-deletion rows, and otherwise limited to queueCatalogBoundary.deletionSubstatusCatalog.
queueLedgerDeletionContract.contentFreeDeletionErrorCodeRule: Nullable when there is no current deletion error; otherwise limited to queueCatalogBoundary.contentFreeDeletionErrorCodeCatalog and forbidden from containing content, identifiers, endpoints, response bodies or credentials. It is null for DELETED_REMOTE.
queueLedgerDeletionContract.eventOutcomeMappingRule: Every remote-deletion row follows queueCatalogBoundary.deletionEventOutcomeMapping; PRESERVE_CURRENT retains the current exact six-value pending substatus and is not a ledger value.

unresolvedSemanticGroups.requiredClosure: Freeze exact domain literals, ordered fields, separator bytes and null encoding for all six names.
Freeze every eligible source, event, guard, target and no-match branch.
Freeze categorical INVALID_INPUT versus REJECTED_NO_STATE_CHANGE outcomes and zero-delta rules.
Freeze attempt, logical effect, application and remote deletion counter increments and replay behavior.
Freeze equality or projection rules between queue local-state digests and flow pre/post state digests.
Freeze snapshot fields, canonical bytes, strict decode failures and exact continuation equality.
Freeze consent, profile and runtime eligibility inputs and categorical outcomes before resumed work.

deletionPhaseContract.PRE_ACCEPTANCE: queue=DELETE_PENDING, required immutable logicalKeyHash and deletionScopeDigest, deletionIdHash=null, deletionReceiptIdHash=null
deletionPhaseContract.POST_ACCEPTANCE: queue=DELETE_PENDING, the same required immutable logicalKeyHash and deletionScopeDigest, immutable non-null deletionIdHash, deletionReceiptIdHash=null

deletionEventOutcomeMapping.deterministicRule: Pre-acceptance: deletionIdHash=null; no transport attempt occurs while denied.
Before acceptance, revalidation, user-action confirmation or manual-retry confirmation preserves deletionIdHash=null and schedules only one bounded eligible acceptance attempt.
After acceptance, deletionIdHash is required and immutable; deletionReceiptIdHash remains null.
Post-acceptance: preserve required immutable deletionIdHash; no transport attempt occurs while denied.
Preserve the current acceptance phase and schedule only bounded eligible work.
Preserve the deletion record and require profile revalidation.
Preserve the deletion record and require scope revalidation.
Preserve the deletion record; no automatic retry.
Preserve the deletion record; no automatic retry.
Preserve the deletion record; no automatic retry.
Preserve the deletion record; no automatic retry.
Preserve the deletion record and schedule no automatic wakeup.
Return REJECTED_NO_STATE_CHANGE; preserve the current substatus and record with zero state change.
Post-acceptance: preserve required immutable deletionIdHash; an explicit revalidation, user-action or manual-retry grant supplies one new positive finite attempt budget.
Require immutable deletionReceiptIdHash; preserve identity and create no second deletion effect.

deletionDirectiveRules.PRESERVE_PHASE: deletionIdHash stays null before durable acceptance evidence and stays the same required immutable hash after acceptance evidence
deletionDirectiveRules.PRESERVE_CURRENT: retain the current exact six-value pending substatus; this directive is not a stored seventh substatus
